* Subclass of ResourceBundle which mimics * ListResourceBundle, but provides more hooks * for specialized subclass behavior. For general description, * see {@link java.util.ListResourceBundle}. *

* This class leaves handleGetObject non-final, and * adds a method createMap which allows subclasses to * use specialized Map implementations.

methods.name: protected Set<String> handleKeySet()
methods.comment:
* Returns a set of keys provided in this resource bundle,
     * including no parents.

methods.name: void loadLookupTablesIfNecessary()
methods.comment: * Load lookup tables if they haven't been loaded already.

methods.name: private void loadLookup()
methods.comment:
* We lazily load the lookup hashtable.  This function does the
     * loading.

methods.name: protected Map<K, V> createMap(int size)
methods.comment:
* Lets subclasses provide specialized Map implementations.
     * Default uses HashMap.
